'''Hanik Jormani''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a [[Sith Inquisitor]] within the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]], he was stationed at [[Dorn Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he shared his knowledge with fellow [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Hanik Jormani appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as a class trainer for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Inquisitor class on Hoth.<ref name="TOR" />
